meta.description: Projects reaching commercial operation in H1 2026, from PFL Table 1. Input to validate_capacity.js, which checks each one appears in either regional_renewable_capacity.json or ipp_pipeline.json.
meta.source: Alao, O. & Kruger, W. (2026, August). South African IPPs: financial close and commercial operations monitor, H1 2026 update. Power Futures Lab, UCT GSB. Table 1, 17 projects, 1 January to 30 June 2026.
meta.capacity_basis: mw_installed is MWac. mw_contracted is firm dispatchable capacity and differs for storage and hybrid projects - see PFL footnote 2.
meta.cod_note: cod is present only where a date was verified from a named source. Projects commissioned BEFORE the IPP Office as_at date sit inside provincial aggregates and will never appear by name, so absence from the named files is expected. Only projects with a cod AFTER as_at must be named somewhere.

projects.name: Mulilo Total Hydra Storage
projects.note: 216 is MWp of solar behind a 75 MW contracted dispatchable output (PFL footnote 2). Sources disagree on COD: PFL places it in H1 2026, Engineering News reports it inaugurated and brought into operation 16 July 2026. Both are after the 31 March IPP Office cutoff.

projects.name: Coleskop
projects.note: Commissioned February 2026 as part of the 420 MW Koruson 1 cluster.

projects.name: Umoyilanga 2 (Dassiesridge)
projects.note: Provisional COD 5 December 2025. Full COD depends on the Avondale component (115 MW solar, 30 MW/90 MWh battery).
